Contact the Bureau of Elections for more information or visit the SOS website at New Mexico Secretary of State . Please Note: Any changes made to your Voter Registration needs to be done 28 days prior to any Election. Overseas Voter? Voting assistance for Service Members, their Families and Overseas Citizens. To submit an application please click on the FVAP Application . For further information please visit www.fvap.gov Candidate information Regular Local Election Training for Candidates The New Mexico Secretary of State’s Office will offer two virtual trainings in Summer 2025 for candidates running for office in the 2025 Regular Local Election (Tuesday, November 4, 2025). These trainings are meant for anyone thinking about running for an office that will appear on the Regular Local Election ballot. These trainings will cover everything RLE candidates need to know about how to interact with our Office during the election, how to qualify for the ballot, and how to file required reports during your candidacy. WHAT: Virtual candidate training for prospective Regular Local Election candidates WHERE: Online (through Microsoft Teams) – link provided upon RSVP WHEN: Either 11am on July 29th, 2025 or 1pm on August 7th, 2025 (These trainings are duplicates. Interested participant only needs to RSVP for either one.) For RSVP to either of these trainings, please email BC Nguyen at bc.nguyen@sos.nm.gov .
